soundClips.notes: Let’s watch some matrices in their natural habitat.
This is an explainer... an easy one.
The good news: the computer will help you create the matrices.
And the computer will multiply the matrices for you.
All you have to do is put them in the right order.
Am I the only one who gets these things backwards
There are only two possibilities. ... wrong every time?
How I stopped guessing ... what's really going on.
Shapes are just a collection of points.
Each operation is a square matrix ... computer creates it for you.
Apply transform to point ... each point in image.
More details... affine matrices are bigger.
And sometimes people don't bother to list out all the terms.
Worthy of further study... 3x1 ... 3x3 ... The computer will take care of the rest for you.
